title: trifolium involucratum var. arizonicum
intro: Trifolium involucratum var. arizonicum, commonly known as Arizona Trifolium, is a plant species within the legume family. It is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. Arizona Trifolium has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include treating gastrointestinal issues and urinary problems due to its diuretic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
